cap_en: To test whether learned mixing pays at every depth, we train Hyper-Connections with and without it at three depths. The deeper the model, the less it pays. One-path Pre-LN stays worst at every depth.
cap_zh: 为检验学到混合是否在各深度都划算，我们在三个深度上训练带与不带它的 Hyper-Connections。模型越深，它越不划算。单通路的 Pre-LN 在每个深度上都最差。
more_en: Hyper-Connections, mHC and AttnRes report that removing learned routing raises the loss at 16 layers. At 48 layers we find that fixing the mixing to the identity lowers the loss. We ask whether depth explains the difference. We train Hyper-Connections at 12 and 24 layers on the same code and the same budget, with full learned mixing and with identity mixing, and include the 48-layer runs. Read and write stay learned in both models, so this change removes only the mixing. The left panel plots the final held-out loss of the last layer. Dots show individual runs and lines join their means. Pre-LN is the model with one path. The right panel plots identity mixing minus full learned mixing at each evaluation step, so a positive value means learned mixing helps. At the end the value is +0.016 nats at 12 layers, −0.020 at 24 and −0.056 at 48. Before the 12- and 24-layer runs started, we predicted at least +0.01, about 0 and about −0.06. The two shallower values sit below 0.03 nats, so we read them as no effect larger than that. The 12-layer value matches the 0.012–0.022 nats that prior papers report at 16 layers with other optimizers and far more tokens. Two seeds of Hyper-Connections at 48 layers differ by 0.041 nats, and each shallower depth has one pair of runs. Only the change from 12 to 48 layers, 0.072 nats, exceeds the difference between seeds. The three depths keep the same order at all five evaluation steps, and each depth ends lower than at step 1,000. Pre-LN stays above identity mixing by 0.061, 0.085 and 0.090 nats at the three depths. Its 12- and 24-layer runs use the older code, which moves Pre-LN by 0.006 nats at 48 layers. An older-code run of Hyper-Connections reaches 3.764 nats at 12 layers and 3.704 at 24, which would put the differences at +0.020 and −0.044. One more 48-layer run with learned mixing overflowed from step 4,408, so we leave it out.
more_zh: Hyper-Connections、mHC 和 AttnRes 报告，在 16 层模型里去掉学到的路由会抬高损失。我们在 48 层模型里发现，把混合固定为单位混合反而会降低损失。我们检验深度是否解释这一差异。我们用同一套代码和相同预算在 12 层和 24 层上训练 Hyper-Connections，分别采用完整学到混合和单位混合，并合入 48 层的运行结果。两个模型都保留学到的读写，所以这一改动只去掉混合。左图画最后一层的最终留出损失。圆点代表单次运行，折线连接均值。Pre-LN 是单通路模型。右图画每个评测步上单位混合减去完整学到混合的差值，所以正值代表学到混合有益。训练结束时，这一差值在 12 层为 +0.016 nats，在 24 层为 −0.020，在 48 层为 −0.056。在 12 层和 24 层运行启动前，我们预测这三个值至少为 +0.01、接近 0 和接近 −0.06。两个较浅深度的数值都低于 0.03 nats，所以我们认为那里不存在超过这一幅度的效应。12 层上的数值与此前论文用其他优化器和多得多的词元在 16 层上报告的 0.012–0.022 nats 一致。48 层 Hyper-Connections 的两个种子相差 0.041 nats，两个较浅深度则各有一对运行。所以只有从 12 层到 48 层的 0.072 nats 变化量超过了种子间的差距。三个深度在全部 5 个评测步上保持同一顺序，而且每个深度在终点都比第 1,000 步时更低。在三个深度上，Pre-LN 的损失始终比单位混合高 0.061、0.085 和 0.090 nats。它的 12 层和 24 层运行使用旧代码，而旧代码在 48 层上使 Pre-LN 偏移 0.006 nats。旧代码下的 Hyper-Connections 在 12 层达到 3.764 nats，在 24 层达到 3.704，换算出的差值为 +0.020 和 −0.044。另有一次带学到混合的 48 层运行从第 4,408 步起溢出，所以我们排除它。
